risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions, including inflation, high interest rates, and economic uncertainty, have a significant and persistent impact on advertising spending, particularly in RR O categories which have experienced six years of weakness since late 2023.

risks.title: Advertiser Loss and Churn
risks.score_rationale: A substantial portion of Yelp's advertisers may cancel their advertising campaigns at any time. Declining satisfaction or macroeconomic conditions could lead to significant advertising revenue churn.

risks.title: Decline in Traffic and User Engagement
risks.score_rationale: A decline in traffic or engagement on the platform would reduce the number of ads displayed and their value to businesses. Changes in consumer behavior due to weakened economic conditions directly impact revenues.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Yelp operates in a highly competitive local digital advertising market. Competition from emerging platforms and technology giants could erode market share and revenues.

risks.title: AI Adoption Risks
risks.score_rationale: Yelp is making substantial investments in new AI-powered products and its AI transformation 2026, which are unproven and carry significant risks. These investments may not generate sufficient ROI, and revenue increases may lag behind expense increases.

ai_positioning.summary: Yelp positions AI as a central element of its 2026 strategy. The company has integrated AI capabilities into Yelp Assistant (photo recognition, memory), launched Yelp Host and Yelp Receptionist (LLM-powered call answering services), and announced 55+ new AI-powered products in 2025 including natural language search and AI-powered highlights.
evidence: Yelp Host: LLM-powered call answering service, launched Q3 2025, handled over 190,000 calls
Yelp Receptionist: AI-powered call answering service for service pros
Yelp Assistant: enhanced with AI-powered photo recognition and ability to remember project details
55+ new products and features announced in 2025, most powered by AI
Substantial investment plans in AI transformation planned for 2026
